source.quote_free_summary: Within ten days after the competition the organizer delivers the computer scrutineering files (from NDCA Premier or CMPMGR) to the Ballroom Department; original score sheets are retained for thirty days.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must produce the files and track the deadline.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED.  DanceFlow does not verify or fulfill it; it remains the organizer's responsibility (R-14) unless DanceFlow explicitly implements and verifies it in a future body profile. It must not block eligible Studio/Custom competitions.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Re-read 2026-11-24. DanceFlow produces no such file and does not report to NDCA. BLOCKER for an NDCA profile.
